idiom.title: Keep something under one’s hat
idiom.interpretationEn: The phrase originates from the 18th and 19th-century British custom of sometimes hiding valuable small items under a hat to prevent theft. Hats were considered very personal items and symbols of individual privacy. Thus, “keep something under one’s hat” means keeping something hidden from others, maintaining secrecy.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个短语源自 18、19 世纪英国的习俗，当时人们有时候会把贵重的小物品藏在帽子下以免被盗。帽子被认为是非常私人的物品，也是个人秘密的象征。所以 “keep something under one’s hat” 意思就是把某事隐藏起来，不为他人所知。

examples.en: I have some exciting news, but you gotta keep it under your hat for now.
examples.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息，但你现在得保密。

examples.en: He was told to keep the project under his hat until the official announcement.
examples.zh: 他被告知在正式宣布之前要对这个项目保密。

examples.en: They managed to keep the surprise party under their hats until the last minute.
examples.zh: 他们设法保密了惊喜派对，直到最后一刻。

people.name: Neil Young
people.extract: Neil Percival Young is a Canadian and American singer-songwriter and musician. Young's deeply personal lyrics and signature high tenor singing voice define his long career. Young's often distorted electric guitar playing, especially with his backing band Crazy Horse, earned him the nickname "Godfather of Grunge" and led to his 1995 album Mirror Ball with Pearl Jam. He also plays piano and harmonica on many albums, which frequently combine folk, rock, country, and other musical genres.
highlights: Singer-songwriter known for high tenor voice.
Released "Mirror Ball" album with Pearl Jam.

people.name: Benjamin Mkapa
people.extract: Benjamin William Mkapa was the third president of Tanzania, in office from 1995 to 2005. He was Chairman of the Revolutionary State Political Party.
highlights: Served as third president of Tanzania.
Chairman of Revolutionary State Political Party.

people.name: Anne Hathaway
people.extract: Anne Jacqueline Hathaway is an American actress. Her work encompasses both screen and stage, and her accolades include an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, a Golden Globe Award, a Screen Actors Guild Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award, in addition to two other Golden Globe nominations. Her films have grossed more than $6.7 billion worldwide.
highlights: Won an Academy Award and Golden Globe.
